verdicts.note: Direction and magnitude hold: he has never held elected office [S1] and works as a private-sector wealth advisor [S1][S5]. High confidence overstates it. He does not campaign on renewal or outsider status. For an open seat he runs on fiduciary and compliance credentials [S1][S5], so his place toward 'new voices' is inferred from his profile, not taken from repeated explicit statements. Medium matches the adjustment made for the Grant sheriff challenger.
